name: Life Sim
description: Small needs, long consequences. The pack runs on the idea that autonomy is more interesting than obedience: social.needs_decay drives characters to act on their own, and the player's role is to arrange a life in which those actions go well rather than to issue orders. Moodlets are the memory that makes that legible -- a character who was embarrassed this morning is a different character this afternoon -- and social.relationship_graph is what turns two such characters meeting into a story rather than an animation. Career and furnishing sit on top as the two long arcs the player actually steers, and both are deliberately slower than the needs beneath them.
loop: fulfill needs → build relationships → advance career → decorate home

signatureCompound.name: A Bad Morning Becomes a Bad Date
signatureCompound.description: Why this genre needs a memory: needs_decay lets energy bottom out overnight, moodlet_system records the resulting exhaustion as a stacking modifier, career_track's morning shift goes badly because of it, and relationship_graph reads the whole chain when the character meets someone that evening. One unmet need, four hours later, a different conversation.
